consequence.statement: Disabling the ContinueReconciliationOnManualRollingUpdateFailure feature gate is no longer possible: it is now GA and permanently enabled, so a configuration that disables it no longer takes effect.
consequence.remediation: Remove the setting that disables ContinueReconciliationOnManualRollingUpdateFailure, and check that your setup works with the feature always on.

assertion.statement: In Strimzi 0.46.0 the ContinueReconciliationOnManualRollingUpdateFailure feature gate moves to GA and is permanently enabled, so it can no longer be disabled.
